text:
jess (Docs): Opening a short thread to finalize wording for audit export + retention. Quick PR incoming. Need alignment on default retention, KMS rotation, and a tiny PII redaction example.

omar (Security): Avoid 'permanent' or 'irreversible'. Recommend: 'retained until the configured retention period or customer-requested deletion.' Call out that key destruction can make data unrecoverable.

maria (Legal): Also need an auditor-friendly deletion proof example (log snippet) and a short retention policy sample.

jess (Docs): Draft sentence: "Audit exports are retained per-customer per the configured retention period (default 90 days). Exports are encrypted with the customer's KMS key; rotated keys remain usable if prior key versions are preserved by the KMS. If a key is destroyed, exports encrypted with that key may be unrecoverable. Customers can request deletion; Redwood logs deletion events to provide an audit trail." Thoughts?

ben (DevEx): Looks good. I'll update the CLI/SDK examples for v2. Suggested CLI: `ri audit export --start 2025-03-01 --end 2025-03-31 --kms-key arn:aws:kms:...:key/my-key --output s3://acme/audit-mar.ndjson`. Add curl + python streaming examples.

omar (Security): For redaction show a tiny JSON example and recommend redaction before export: `{"ts":"...","user_id":"[REDACTED]","action":"login"}`. Mention hashing as alternative.

maria (Legal): Deletion proof example: `deleted_export: {"export_id":"e-123","deleted_at":"2025-03-10T12:00:00Z","actor":"support@acme.com"}`. That should help auditors.

jess (Docs): Great — I'll add those and swap any retired runbook links. @docs-bot can you post the canonical runbook URL please?

docs-bot: Canonical runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/audit-export-guidance (link-id: runbook.audit.exports.guidance). Link map updated.

jess (Docs): Thanks. I'll push the branch in ~20m and request legal + security reviews. Ping me if you want micro-phrasing changes inline in the PR.

omar (Security): I'll review tonight. If it's small, I'll approve.

maria (Legal): I'll do a quick pass after lunch. If we need a sample retention table for contracts, I can draft it.

ben (DevEx): After merge I'll add the updated examples to the SDK migration checklist.

jess (Docs): Thanks everyone — short and sweet. :pray:
